

:::{#thm-cond-exch}

If subpopulations defined by values of exposure $X$ are 
conditionally exchangeable with
respect to potential outcome $\potout{x}$ given covariate $\vZ$, then
the expected value of $\potout{x}$ does not depend on the observed value of $X$:

$$\Expf{\potout{x} \given X = x', \vZ=\vz} = \Expf{\potout{x} \given X = x, \vZ=\vz}$$

:::
